exposure.cause: A routine launch-log tail displayed the first seven per-arm progress lines.

response.monitoring_policy: Until phase completion, inspect only process state, shard counts, terminal artifacts and error-pattern presence; do not tail normal per-arm outcome lines.

validity_assessment: The exposure does not drive selection because every treatment, control, seed, endpoint and gate was already frozen. It is nevertheless disclosed and no adaptive decision may use the seven lines.
